svg.title: 1-roll v2 perfboard layout
svg.text: 1-roll v2: perfboard layout (90 × 150 mm dot board, component side)
Modules sit in female headers so they can be swapped. Probes, blower and load cells use JST-XH sockets; the screen a 14-pin header; only 12 V in uses a screw terminal.
Heater current never runs on the board:
14 AWG from TF1 to the heater, heater −
soldered to Q1's drain leg, and Q1's
source leg straight back to J1's black wire.
The HX711s sit at the far end from Q1
and the MP1584: switching adds scale noise.
Wire 3V3 and GND as two bare buses
J9 to the screen: 14 short Dupont wires
(or a ribbon), under 20 cm for 40 MHz SPI.
